description: This file contains source code for relational storage tests, including utility methods for inserting and reading streams, and handling cancellation tests in an ADO.NET context within the Orleans framework. It defines data models, base test classes, and internal methods for database operations related to streaming data.

classes.name: StreamingTest
classes.description: Data model class used for streaming tests, containing an ID and byte array stream data.

classes.name: RelationalStoreTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for relational storage tests, providing common setup and utility methods for testing streaming database operations and cancellation handling.

methods.name: InsertAndReadStreamsAndCheckMatch
methods.description: Inserts multiple byte streams into the database and reads them back to verify data integrity, executing operations in parallel.

methods.name: InsertIntoDatabaseUsingStream
methods.description: Inserts a byte array into the database as a stream, supporting large data transfer with sequential access.

methods.name: ReadFromDatabaseUsingAsyncStream
methods.description: Reads a stream of data from the database asynchronously, returning a StreamingTest object containing an ID and byte array.

methods.name: CancellationTokenTest
methods.description: Performs a read operation from the database with a CancellationToken to test proper cancellation handling and timeout behavior.
